column1: # size budget (docs/README.md, "Size budget"), tracked by scripts/check-docs.sh,
# that are not exempt (check-docs.sh's SIZE_EXEMPT). The as-built
# specifications are exempt rather than listed here, because AGENTS.md
# requires them to grow with every requirement-affecting change and no entry
# could hold one still; #2094, which splits the implementation and dashboard
# specifications into files within the budget, is their fix.
# Format: path<TAB>bytes<TAB>issue — `bytes` is the most hand-written content
# this file may hold, its size outside generated regions, the measure
# check-docs.sh applies; `issue` is the GitHub issue (bare number) that will
# bring it under budget. Entries may only shrink (a falling byte count, or a
# removed line); never add slack by raising one. An entry for a file that is
# missing, exempt or back within the budget fails the check: delete it.
